name: INEOS
verdict: The brand of INEOS Group, privately owned by founder Sir Jim Ratcliffe and co-owners Andy Currie and John Reece.
note: UK chemicals and energy group. INEOS has owned the team outright since 2019 (Tour Racing Limited); co-title sponsor of Netcompany INEOS, with INEOS on the chest, back, sleeves and shorts of the 2026 kit and 'GRENADIER' (the INEOS Grenadier 4x4 brand) on the leg hems.
